_comment: the authoritative Feature_Catalog. Each language's server declares the
supported/unsupported half of every feature here in its own feature-config.json;
the union must equal this catalog. Each feature names one keyring or CMM
a Language_Server may implement. Add a feature here together with the
model operations and Tests that exercise it.
NOT TESTED: MPL behavior the Dafny MPL tests cover that has no model operation
or Feature here, and no Tests.
- Raw RSA and AWS KMS RSA keyrings: the native Rust MPL has no RSA.
- Raw ECDH and AWS KMS ECDH keyrings: the native Rust MPL has no ECDH.
- Required Encryption Context CMM: the native Rust MPL has none.
success set): GetEncryptionMaterialsRequest has no such member, so only
the reproducedEncryptionContext half of that set is ported.
- Missing-plaintext-data-key vectors (AllDefaultCmm.dfy): they need a static
keyring that returns a fixed or absent data key; the model has none.
- AWS KMS hierarchical keyring and branch key store: not yet modeled.
